project.title: Dextryx Pixels
project.tagline: A Flutter image editing product focused on GPU preview and reliability.

summary.short: Dextryx Pixels is a Flutter image editing product with an emphasis on GPU-backed preview, camera and film workflows, and repeatable reliability validation on real devices.
summary.long: GPU preview and the G6 reliability track are closed and verified. Current validation is focused on PF9 physical smoke evidence for native preview suspension behavior and the remaining production-oriented preview workflow closure.

highlights: G6 reliability track closed and verified
PF9 physical smoke validation in progress
